tsca_cou_category: Domestic manufacturing
cdr_form_u_section: Part II Section C (Manufacturing information)
cdr_data_element: Domestically manufactured (yes/no) and annual production volume
notes: Both programs flag manufacture at the reporting site. CDR reports every site that manufactured 25,000 lb or more (2,500 lb for certain TSCA actions); TRI reports only facilities in covered NAICS sectors with 10 or more FTEs that exceed the chemical threshold.
sources: EPA COU Development deck (Oct 2023), slides 4, 7, 8, 11; CDR 2020 Instructions Part II Sec. C (4.7); 40 CFR 711.15(b)(3); TRI Basic Plus File Type 1B (RY2023), fields 92 to 145

tsca_cou_category: Domestic manufacturing
cdr_form_u_section: Part II Section C (Manufacturing information)
cdr_data_element: Volume used on site (site-limited volume)
cdr_code_description: Production volume used at the manufacturing site (no code)
notes: CDR reports the volume consumed on site; TRI flags whether a produced or imported chemical is further processed or otherwise used at the same facility.
sources: CDR 2020 Instructions Part II Sec. C (4.7); 40 CFR 711.15(b)(3); TRI Basic Plus File Type 1B (RY2023), fields 92 to 145

tsca_cou_category: Domestic manufacturing
cdr_form_u_section: Part II Section C (Manufacturing information)
cdr_data_element: Percent of production volume that is a byproduct (voluntary, CDR 2020 Sec. 4.7.2.9)
notes: CDR byproducts are reportable only when put to a separate commercial purpose (40 CFR 711.10(c), 720.30(g)); TRI reports byproducts regardless of commercial purpose. Volume basis differs (percent vs. yes/no).
sources: CDR 2020 Instructions Part II Sec. C (4.7); 40 CFR 711.15(b)(3); TRI Basic Plus File Type 1B (RY2023), fields 92 to 145

tsca_cou_category: Domestic manufacturing or Importing
cdr_form_u_section: Not reported (exempt)
cdr_data_element: Impurities are not reportable under CDR (40 CFR 711.10(c), 720.30(h)(1))
notes: TRI counts a chemical manufactured as an impurity toward the manufacture threshold; CDR exempts chemicals manufactured solely as impurities.
sources: CDR 2020 Instructions Part II Sec. C (4.7); 40 CFR 711.15(b)(3); TRI Basic Plus File Type 1B (RY2023), fields 92 to 145

tsca_cou_category: Importing
cdr_form_u_section: Part II Section C (Manufacturing information)
cdr_data_element: Imported (yes/no); imported chemical never physically at site (yes/no); import volume

sources: EPA COU Development deck (Oct 2023), slides 4, 7, 8, 11; CDR 2020 Instructions Part II Sec. C (4.7); 40 CFR 711.15(b)(3); TRI Basic Plus File Type 1B (RY2023), fields 92 to 145
